prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single, objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right attorney depends on the specifics of your crash (severity of injuries, fault issues, uninsured/underinsured driver, commercial vehicle, Uber/Lyft, motorcycle, etc.), your budget, and whether you want an aggressive trial lawyer or a negotiator who settles quickly.

What matters most
- Experience with car-accident cases similar to yours (catastrophic injury, wrongful death, low-impact soft-tissue, uninsured motorist, rideshare, commercial truck).  
- Trial experience and a record of jury verdicts (if your case needs a lawsuit/trial).  
- Documented results (verdicts/settlements), peer ratings (Martindale‑Hubbell AV, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers), and client reviews.  
- Resources to marshal medical experts and accident reconstruction if needed.  
- Clear fee structure (contingency fee % and who pays costs if you don’t recover).  
- Good communication and responsiveness.

How to find the best fit
- Look up top-rated Chicago firms and attorneys on SuperLawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, Best Lawyers, and client-review sites (Google, Avvo).  
- Ask for recent case results and references.  
- Meet 2–4 lawyers for free consultations to compare strategy, estimated timeline, and fees.  
- Ask whether they handle your type of case, their trial rate, and who in the firm will handle most of the work.

Well-known Chicago names (examples to consider)
- Clifford Law Offices — nationally known in Chicago for catastrophic automobile and wrongful-death cases.  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard — established personal-injury practice in Chicago.  

(These are examples — many excellent boutique trial lawyers and midsize firms in Chicago may be a better fit depending on your case.)

Practical next steps
1. Tell me brief details about your accident (date, injuries, at-fault driver/insurance, police report, whether you’ve treated medically). I can suggest 3–5 Chicago attorneys or firms who commonly handle similar claims and include links/phone numbers and what to ask them.  
2. Or search SuperLawyers/Avvo/Martindale for “Chicago personal injury car accident” and contact 3 firms for free consults.

If you want, provide some case details now and I’ll find and recommend specific local attorneys tailored to your situation.
